text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both posting solid single-day gains, with ETH outpacing BTC slightly, suggesting strength across the two majors rather than Bitcoin-only momentum. The Fear & Greed index at 74 and climbing indicates market participants are in risk-on territory, though not yet at euphoria levels. Bitcoin dominance holding steady near 60% combined with $113B in daily volume reflects healthy breadth—retail and institutional interest are both present without signs of overextension.
